Docs.summary: Marks an eligible native method to use the fastest available Java Native Interface (JNI) transitions.

remarks.para: A critical native method must be static and must not use managed objects in its parameters or return value. The attribute changes the JNI transition ABI, so the native implementation must omit the JNIEnv and jclass parameters.

While a critical native method executes, garbage collection cannot suspend its thread and may be blocked. Do not use this attribute on long-running methods or methods that perform significant I/O or acquire native locks that can be held for a long time. This attribute has no effect on non-native methods.
